landscape_summary: Globex owns the upmarket suite position and is raising prices.
Initech wins on price; Umbrella sidesteps price by charging on attributed sales.
whitespace: No app pairs a free plan that includes review requests with Google Shopping sync.

d0_30: Add a 'switch from Globex' import path and mention it on the listing.
m1_3: Ship Google Shopping sync on the Growth plan.
m3_12: Explore a video-review format to blunt Umbrella.

recommended_strategy: Hold the free plan, target Globex's price-sensitive mid-market merchants.

battlecard_counters.globex-reviews: Same core features for less — and the free plan actually sends review requests.
battlecard_counters.initech-ratings: Photo and video reviews when a store outgrows plain stars.
battlecard_counters.umbrella-ugc: Flat pricing: no cut of your sales.
